tutorial.welcome.en: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.welcome.text: Káàbọ̀, aṣáájú ọ̀dọ́. Èmi ni Ọ̀gá Hoshi. Ìdílé wa ti rí àfonífojì àṣírí kan láàrin àwọn òkè. Ẹ jẹ́ ká kọ́ abúlé tí abánidíje kankan kò ní rí.

tutorial.mint.collect.en: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.collect.text: Ilé Ìṣẹ́ Owó rẹ ń ṣe Owó-ẹyọ. Nígbà tí owó kan bá léfòó lórí rẹ̀, tẹ̀ ẹ́, lẹ́yìn náà tẹ Kó jọ.

tutorial.mint.build.en: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.mint.build.text: Owó-ẹyọ ni ìdílé fi ń ṣiṣẹ́. Tẹ Kọ́ kí o sì gbé Ilé Ìṣẹ́ Owó kan kalẹ̀.

tutorial.keep.en: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.keep.text: Nísinsìnyí fún Ilé Olódi Ìdílé lágbára: tẹ ilé olódi náà, lẹ́yìn náà Ṣe àgbéga.

tutorial.finishKeep.wait.en: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait.text: Àgbéga máa ń gba àkókò. Ilé Olódi yóò ṣetán ní {time}: padà wá nígbà náà, tàbí tẹ Parí báyìí láti lo Jéèdì díẹ̀.

tutorial.finishKeep.done.en: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.finishKeep.done.text: Ilé Olódi ti ṣetán. O ṣeun púpọ̀!

tutorial.army.tower.en: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.tower.text: Àwọn ìdílé abánidíje yóò gbógun tì wá. Kọ́ Ilé-ìṣọ́ Kunai kan lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Ilé Olódi (Kọ́, lẹ́yìn náà táàbù Ààbò): ó ń ta agbógunti èyíkéyìí tí ó bá wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó.

tutorial.army.all.en: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.army.all.text: Kọ́ Dojo Ìdánrawò kan, Àgbàlá Ẹgbẹ́ Ogun kan àti Ilé-ìṣọ́ Kunai kan lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ Ilé Olódi (Kọ́: táàbù Ọmọ ogun, lẹ́yìn náà táàbù Ààbò).

tutorial.train.en: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.train.text: Ṣí pánẹ́ẹ̀lì Ọmọ ogun kí o sì dá àwọn Shinobi díẹ̀ lẹ́kọ̀ọ́: idà yíyára tí ó ń kọlu ilé tí ó sún mọ́ wọn jùlọ.

tutorial.finishTrain.wait.en: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait.text: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà ń gba àkókò: àwọn jagunjagun rẹ yóò ṣetán ní {time}. Dúró, tàbí tẹ Parí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ láti lo Jéèdì díẹ̀.

tutorial.raid.en: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.raid.text: Ìgbógunti rẹ àkọ́kọ́. Tẹ Kọlù, wo ibi àfojúsùn náà dáadáa, lẹ́yìn náà Kọlù! Lójú ogun, màá fi nǹkan kan hàn ọ́ lẹ́ẹ̀kan: rán àwọn Shinobi rẹ wọlé gba ojú tí ń tàn, lẹ́yìn náà da èéfín bò wọ́n bí wọ́n ṣe dé ilé-ìṣọ́ kan: àwọn jagunjagun inú èéfín ni a lè ta láti tòsí nìkan.

tutorial.end.en: Well fought. Raids fill your storage fast: upgrade the Clan Keep (or a storage) next. Then upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
tutorial.end.text: O jà dáadáa. Ìgbógunti máa ń kún àwọn àká rẹ kíákíá: ṣe àgbéga Ilé Olódi Ìdílé (tàbí àká kan) tẹ̀lé e. Lẹ́yìn náà, ṣe àgbéga Dojo Ìdánrawò láti ṣí àwọn Abàjẹ́: wọ́n ń dí ilé ààbò kan lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀. Kọ́kọ́ dí i lọ́wọ́, lẹ́yìn náà kọlù, kí o sì da èéfín bo àwọn jagunjagun rẹ níbi tí iná ti le jùlọ. Kó jọ, ṣe àgbéga, gbógun ti, kí o sì darapọ̀ mọ́ Àjọṣepọ̀ kan.

calendar.about.en: One reward a day, the same for everyone, never random and never sold. Miss a day and nothing is lost: the next claim is the next day on the list. Day 28 gives a Keep look.
calendar.about.text: Ẹ̀bùn kan lójoojúmọ́, bákan náà fún gbogbo ènìyàn, kì í ṣe láìròtẹ́lẹ̀, a kì í sì í tà á. Tí o bá pàdánù ọjọ́ kan, kò sí ohun tí ó sọnù: ìgbà tí o bá gbà tó kàn ni ọjọ́ tó kàn lórí àtòjọ. Ọjọ́ 28 ń fún ọ ní ìrísí Ilé Olódi.

calendar.gotLook.en: A new Keep look is yours: Store → Looks.
calendar.gotLook.text: Ìrísí Ilé Olódi tuntun jẹ́ tìrẹ: Ọjà → Ìrísí.

offers.noAge.en: Special offers appear only once you have told us your age (Settings → Account → Spending → Set age group).
offers.noAge.text: Àwọn ìfilọ̀ àkànṣe máa ń hàn kìkì lẹ́yìn tí o bá ti sọ ọjọ́ orí rẹ fún wa (Ètò → Àkáǹtì → Ìnáwó → Ṣètò ẹgbẹ́ ọjọ́ orí).

offers.minor.en: Special offers do not pop up for players under 18. Everything in the Jade tab stays available within your spending limit.
offers.minor.text: Àwọn ìfilọ̀ àkànṣe kì í yọ jáde fún àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé ọmọ ọdún 18. Gbogbo ohun tí ó wà nínú táàbù Jéèdì ṣì wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó láàrin ààlà ìnáwó rẹ.

settings.languageNote.text: Eré náà ń tẹ̀lé èdè ẹ̀rọ rẹ nígbà tí ó bá lè ṣe é. Àwọn èdè mìíràn ń dé bí a ṣe ń parí ìtumọ̀ wọn.

store.withdrawalStipend.en: Delivery starts at once: the first payment can be claimed now and one more each day; by buying you agree that you lose the right to cancel, as the law allows for digital content.
store.withdrawalStipend.text: Ìfijíṣẹ́ bẹ̀rẹ̀ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀: o lè gba ìsanwó àkọ́kọ́ báyìí àti ọ̀kan sí i lójoojúmọ́; nípa rírà, o gbà pé o pàdánù ẹ̀tọ́ láti fagilé, bí òfin ṣe gbà láàyè fún ohun oní-nọ́ńbà.

store.error.cancelled.text: A fagilé rírà náà. A kò gba owó kankan.

store.error.unavailable.en: Purchases are not available right now. Try again later.
store.error.unavailable.text: Rírà kò sí báyìí. Gbìyànjú lẹ́yìn náà.

store.error.failed.en: The purchase did not go through. If you were charged, it is delivered as soon as the store confirms it.
store.error.failed.text: Rírà náà kò ṣeé ṣe. Tí a bá ti gba owó rẹ, a ó fi í jíṣẹ́ ní kété tí ọjà náà bá fìdí rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

raid.rejected.defender_protected.text: Abúlé yẹn ti ní apata tẹ́lẹ̀.

raid.rejected.no_warriors.en: No warriors fought, so it counts as practice.
raid.rejected.no_warriors.text: Kò sí jagunjagun tí ó jà, nítorí náà ìdánrawò ni a kà á sí.

temper.intro.en: Shape every {building} at once. Reach shoots farther but hits softer and goes for back-line warriors first; Blast hits groups but fires slower; Watch makes the Sky Bow Tower, the Bitter Smoke Brazier and traps stronger. Raiders see the shape when they scout.
temper.intro.text: Ṣe àtúntò gbogbo {building} lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà. Ìnàjìnnà ń ta jìnnà ṣùgbọ́n ń bani jẹ́ díẹ̀, ó sì ń kọ́kọ́ dojú kọ àwọn jagunjagun ẹ̀yìn; Ìbúgbàù ń kọlu àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ṣùgbọ́n ń ta lọ́ra; Ìṣọ́ ń mú Ilé-ìṣọ́ Ọfà Ojú Ọ̀run, Àdògán Èéfín Kíkorò àti àwọn ìdẹkùn lágbára sí i. Àwọn agbógunti ń rí àtúntò náà nígbà tí wọ́n bá ṣe amí.

temper.locked.text: Ìpọ́n-irin máa ń ṣí ní Ilé Olódi Ìdílé {level}.

temper.left.en: {n, plural, one {# point left} other {# points left}}

temper.done.en: Tempered: every {building} has its new shape.
temper.done.text: A ti pọ́n ọn: gbogbo {building} ti ní àtúntò tuntun.

temper.watchSupport.en: Watch also weakens the raiders' healing, revives, toughness and shield cover across the whole base.
temper.watchSupport.text: Ìṣọ́ tún ń dín ìwòsàn, ìjíǹde, agbára àti ààbò apata àwọn agbógunti kù káàkiri gbogbo ibùdó.

scout.profile.text: A ti pọ́n ọn: Ìnàjìnnà {reach} · Ìbúgbàù {blast} · Ìṣọ́ {watch}

stake.help.en: Declare a result before you attack: reach it and carry more loot home, miss it and carry none.
stake.help.text: Kéde àbájáde kan kí o tó kọlù: dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀, ìkógun púpọ̀ sí i yóò wá sílé; kùnà, kò sí èyíkéyìí.

stake.met.text: O dé ìfidógò: {stars}★ mú ìkógun ×{mult} wá.

stake.missed.en: Stake missed: you declared {stars}★, so no loot came home.
stake.missed.text: O kùnà ìfidógò: o kéde {stars}★, nítorí náà kò sí ìkógun tí ó wá sílé.

carry.diversity.en: Your squad carried {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.
carry.diversity.text: Ẹgbẹ́ rẹ kó {pct} nínú ìkógun náà. Ẹgbẹ́ tí ó ní ipa púpọ̀ ń kó púpọ̀ sí i.

carry.preview.en: This army would carry {pct} of the loot. Squads of more roles carry more.

news.offline.en: Messages from the game's operators arrive when you play online.
news.offline.text: Ọ̀rọ̀ láti ọ̀dọ̀ àwọn olùṣàkóso eré máa ń dé nígbà tí o bá ń ṣeré lórí ayélujára.

account.signOutDevice.note.en: Finished playing on this phone or browser? Sign it out. Your online account stays for your other devices and linked sign-ins.
account.signOutDevice.note.text: Ṣé o ti parí eré lórí fóònù tàbí aṣàwákiri yìí? Jáde níbẹ̀. Àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ ṣì wà fún àwọn ẹ̀rọ rẹ mìíràn àti ọ̀nà ìwọlé tí o so.

account.signOutDevice.title.text: Ṣé kí o jáde lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí?

account.signOutDevice.body.en: Online play turns off here and this device forgets its key to your online account. The village on this device stays. To play the account here again, sign in with a linked Apple, Google or Game Center account.
account.signOutDevice.body.text: Eré orí ayélujára yóò kú níbí, ẹ̀rọ yìí yóò sì gbàgbé kọ́kọ́rọ́ rẹ̀ sí àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ. Abúlé tí ó wà lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí yóò wà níbẹ̀. Láti tún ṣe àkáǹtì náà níbí, wọlé pẹ̀lú àkáǹtì Apple, Google tàbí Game Center tí o so.

account.signOutDevice.done.en: This device is signed out. Online play is off here.
account.signOutDevice.done.text: O ti jáde lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí. Eré orí ayélujára ti kú níbí.

account.signOutDevice.lastKey.en: Not signed out: this device holds the only key to your online account. Link Apple, Google or Game Center first, or delete the account instead.
account.signOutDevice.lastKey.text: O kò jáde: ẹ̀rọ yìí nìkan ló ní kọ́kọ́rọ́ sí àkáǹtì orí ayélujára rẹ. Kọ́kọ́ so Apple, Google tàbí Game Center, tàbí kí o pa àkáǹtì náà rẹ́ dípò bẹ́ẹ̀.

news.reason.resources.en: There were not enough resources in your village on the server.
news.reason.resources.text: Ohun-ìní kò tó nínú abúlé rẹ lórí sáfà.

news.reason.builder.text: Kò sí Oníṣẹ́-ọnà Abúlé tí ọwọ́ rẹ̀ dilẹ̀.

news.reason.maxLevel.en: It was already at its highest level.
news.reason.maxLevel.text: Ó ti wà ní ìpele rẹ̀ tí ó ga jùlọ tẹ́lẹ̀.

news.reason.gone.en: It was no longer in your village.
news.reason.gone.text: Kò sí nínú abúlé rẹ mọ́.

news.reason.busy.en: It was already being worked on.
news.reason.busy.text: Wọ́n ti ń ṣiṣẹ́ lórí rẹ̀ tẹ́lẹ̀.

news.reason.limit.en: The limit for it was already reached.

news.reason.locked.text: A kò tíì ṣí i sílẹ̀.

news.reason.army.text: Àwọn Àgbàlá Ẹgbẹ́ Ogun rẹ ti kún.

news.reason.changed.en: Your village had already changed, for example on another device.
news.reason.changed.text: Abúlé rẹ ti yí padà tẹ́lẹ̀, fún àpẹẹrẹ lórí ẹ̀rọ mìíràn.

refusal.storageFullRefund.en: Storage is too full: cancelling now would lose {lost} of the {refund} you would get back. Make room first.
refusal.storageFullRefund.text: Àwọn àká ti kún jù: fífagilé báyìí yóò mú kí {lost} sọnù nínú {refund} tí wàá gbà padà. Kọ́kọ́ ṣe àyè.

league.boardOnline.en: The leaderboards are part of online play.
league.boardOnline.text: Àtẹ ipò jẹ́ apá kan eré orí ayélujára.

sheet.raidRule.en: Raiders can take {pct} of what your storages hold, never more than {cap} of each resource while your Keep is level {level}, and {collectors} of what your collectors have not collected yet.
sheet.raidRule.text: Àwọn agbógunti lè kó {pct} nínú ohun tí ó wà nínú àwọn àká rẹ, kò ju {cap} lọ fún ohun-ìní kọ̀ọ̀kan nígbà tí Ilé Olódi rẹ wà ní ìpele {level}, àti {collectors} nínú ohun tí o kò tíì kó jọ láti inú àwọn akójọ rẹ.

sheet.collectorPause.en: It produces nothing while it upgrades ({time}). What it holds now stays and can still be collected.
sheet.collectorPause.text: Kò ní pèsè nǹkankan nígbà tí a bá ń ṣe àgbéga rẹ̀ ({time}). Ohun tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀ báyìí yóò wà níbẹ̀, o sì ṣì lè kó o jọ.

unlock.title.en: {n, plural, one {New warrior unlocked!} other {New warriors unlocked!}}
unlock.title.text: {n, plural, other {A ti ṣí jagunjagun tuntun sílẹ̀!}}

keep.armyBehind.en: Your warriors' training is more than a Keep behind your village: a higher Keep meets stronger rivals and raiders. Research or train first?
keep.armyBehind.text: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àwọn jagunjagun rẹ ti fi ju ìpele Ilé Olódi kan lọ sẹ́yìn abúlé rẹ: Ilé Olódi tí ó ga jù ń pàdé àwọn abánidíje àti agbógunti tí ó lágbára jù. Ṣé o fẹ́ kọ́kọ́ ṣe ìwádìí tàbí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́?

scout.lootWontFit.en: Your storage cannot hold all the loot on offer: what does not fit is lost.
scout.lootWontFit.text: Àwọn àká rẹ kò lè gba gbogbo ìkógun tí ó wà níbí: èyí tí kò bá gbà yóò sọnù.

trials.caughtUp.en: Tiers {from} to {to} are counted as cleared too, each paid once.
trials.caughtUp.text: A tún ka ìpele {from} sí {to} sí èyí tí o ti parí, a sì san ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan lẹ́ẹ̀kan.

drill.title.text: Ìdánrawò ojoojúmọ́ (ìmúrasílẹ̀: a kò ná nǹkan kan)

drill.about.en: Daily drill: fight this fortress with a full camp of your own warriors. Nothing is spent, and today's first drill pays a small reward.
drill.about.text: Ìdánrawò ojoojúmọ́: bá ibi olódi yìí jà pẹ̀lú ọmọ ogun rẹ tí ó kún àgbàlá. A kò ná nǹkan kan, ìdánrawò àkọ́kọ́ ti òní sì ń san ẹ̀bùn kékeré kan.

drill.paid.en: Drill done: today's reward is paid. Nothing was spent.
drill.paid.text: Ìdánrawò ti parí: a ti san ẹ̀bùn ti òní. A kò ná nǹkan kan.

drill.doneToday.en: Today's drill reward is already paid. You can still drill for practice; the next reward comes tomorrow.
drill.doneToday.text: A ti san ẹ̀bùn ìdánrawò ti òní. O ṣì lè ṣe ìdánrawò fún ìmúrasílẹ̀; ẹ̀bùn tó kàn yóò dé lọ́la.

scout.shieldEnds.en: Your shield has {time} left: attacking ends it.
scout.shieldEnds.text: Apata rẹ ní {time} tí ó kù: kíkọlù yóò parí rẹ̀.

tutorial.end.daily.en: Your first daily chest is ready: Finish opens it.
tutorial.end.daily.text: Àpótí ojoojúmọ́ rẹ àkọ́kọ́ ti ṣetán: Parí yóò ṣí i.

panel.loadFailed.en: This could not open. Check your connection and try again.
panel.loadFailed.text: Èyí kò ṣí. Ṣàyẹ̀wò ìsopọ̀ rẹ kí o sì gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i.

panel.staleChunk.en: A newer version of Kagemura is out. Reload to open this.
panel.staleChunk.text: Ẹ̀dà Kagemura tuntun ti jáde. Tún un ṣí láti ṣí èyí.

quality.slowBattles.en: This phone drew battles slowly, so Kagemura will use lighter graphics from the next start. You can change it in Settings → Graphics.
quality.slowBattles.text: Fóònù yìí ya ogun lọ́ra, nítorí náà Kagemura yóò lo àwòrán tí ó fúyẹ́ láti ìgbà tí o bá tún bẹ̀rẹ̀. O lè yí i padà nínú Ètò → Àwòrán.

events.calendar.server.en: Schedule sent by the game's server. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.server.text: Ètò àkókò tí sáfà eré fi ránṣẹ́. Gbogbo ìkàsẹ̀yìn àkókò jẹ́ òótọ́.

events.calendar.builtIn.en: Built-in schedule. Every countdown is real.
events.calendar.builtIn.text: Ètò àkókò tí ó wà nínú eré. Gbogbo ìkàsẹ̀yìn àkókò jẹ́ òótọ́.

events.fixed.en: Events follow a fixed calendar: a four-week cycle plus five festivals on fixed dates each year. Their times never move or get extended, so the countdown is always the real one.
events.fixed.text: Àwọn ayẹyẹ ń tẹ̀lé kàlẹ́ńdà tí kò yí padà: àyíká ọ̀sẹ̀ mẹ́rin pẹ̀lú ayẹyẹ márùn-ún ní àwọn ọjọ́ tí kò yí padà lọ́dọọdún. Àkókò wọn kì í yí padà, a kì í sì í fà á gùn, nítorí náà ìkàsẹ̀yìn àkókò máa ń jẹ́ òótọ́ nígbà gbogbo.

contract.about.en: The same for everyone today; a new one in {time}. It changes only what a won raid carries home.
contract.about.text: Bákan náà fún gbogbo ènìyàn lónìí; tuntun kan ní {time}. Ohun tí ìgbógunti tí o borí ń kó wá sílé nìkan ni ó ń yí padà.

contract.met.text: O ti mú àdéhùn ojoojúmọ́ ṣẹ: {name}.

events.gauntlet.generated.text: Ibi olódi Ọ̀nà Ìpèníjà (tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe).

events.gauntlet.about.en: A computer-made fortress, the same base for everyone at your Keep this week. No loot inside; each star mark on the ladder pays once.
events.gauntlet.about.text: Ibi olódi tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe, ibi kan náà fún gbogbo ènìyàn ní ìpele Ilé Olódi rẹ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí. Kò sí ìkógun nínú rẹ̀; àmì ìràwọ̀ kọ̀ọ̀kan lórí àtẹ̀gùn ń sanwó lẹ́ẹ̀kan.

events.festival.about.en: A computer-made fortress at your Keep, the same for every attempt. No loot inside; each mark on the ladder pays once, and three stars give the festival's look.
events.festival.about.text: Ibi olódi tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe ní ìpele Ilé Olódi rẹ, bákan náà ní gbogbo ìgbìyànjú. Kò sí ìkógun nínú rẹ̀; àmì kọ̀ọ̀kan lórí àtẹ̀gùn ń sanwó lẹ́ẹ̀kan, ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta sì ń fúnni ní ìrísí ayẹyẹ náà.

store.looksCollected.text: Ìrísí tí o ti kó jọ: {n} nínú {total}

growth.invite.rule.en: When a friend who started with your friend code reaches Keep {keep} with their village on the server, you each get a fixed reward. Nothing random and nothing to buy.
growth.invite.rule.text: Nígbà tí ọ̀rẹ́ kan tí ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ bá dé Ilé Olódi {keep} pẹ̀lú abúlé rẹ̀ lórí sáfà, ẹnì kọ̀ọ̀kan yín yóò gba ẹ̀bùn tí kò yí padà. Kò sí ohun àìròtẹ́lẹ̀, kò sì sí ohun tí a ó rà.

growth.invite.reward.en: Reward for each of you: {jade} Jade
growth.invite.reward.text: Ẹ̀bùn fún ẹnì kọ̀ọ̀kan yín: Jéèdì {jade}

growth.invite.cap.en: {cap, plural, one {Rewards for up to # friend a month.} other {Rewards for up to # friends a month.}}
growth.invite.cap.text: {cap, plural, other {Ẹ̀bùn fún ọ̀rẹ́ tí ó tó # lóṣù.}}

growth.invite.counts.en: Friends who joined with your code: waiting {waiting}, ready {ready}, rewarded {rewarded}
growth.invite.counts.text: Àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ tí ó darapọ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù rẹ: ń dúró {waiting}, ti ṣetán {ready}, ti gba ẹ̀bùn {rewarded}

growth.invite.mine.waiting.en: You joined with a friend's code. Reach Keep {keep} with your village on the server and you both get the reward.
growth.invite.mine.waiting.text: O darapọ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ kan. Dé Ilé Olódi {keep} pẹ̀lú abúlé rẹ lórí sáfà, ẹ̀yin méjèèjì yóò sì gba ẹ̀bùn náà.

growth.invite.mine.ready.en: You joined with a friend's code and reached Keep {keep}: your reward is ready.
growth.invite.mine.ready.text: O darapọ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ kan, o sì ti dé Ilé Olódi {keep}: ẹ̀bùn rẹ ti ṣetán.

growth.invite.mine.rewarded.en: You joined with a friend's code and collected your reward.
growth.invite.mine.rewarded.text: O darapọ̀ pẹ̀lú kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ kan, o sì ti kó ẹ̀bùn rẹ jọ.

growth.invite.needsServer.en: Rewards go to a village on the server. Move your village there in Settings → Online play.
growth.invite.needsServer.text: Ẹ̀bùn máa ń lọ sí abúlé tí ó wà lórí sáfà. Gbé abúlé rẹ lọ síbẹ̀ nínú Ètò → Eré orí ayélujára.

growth.invite.adultsOnly.en: Friend invite rewards are for adults only. You can still add friends and play together.
growth.invite.adultsOnly.text: Ẹ̀bùn ìpè ọ̀rẹ́ wà fún àwọn àgbàlagbà nìkan. O ṣì lè fi ọ̀rẹ́ kún un kí ẹ sì jọ ṣeré.

growth.invite.collected.text: A ti kó o jọ: Jéèdì {jade}

growth.invite.nothing.text: Kò sí nǹkan láti kó jọ síbẹ̀.

growth.invite.enterHint.en: {days, plural, one {Enter their friend code within # day of starting online play.} other {Enter their friend code within # days of starting online play.}}
growth.invite.enterHint.text: {days, plural, other {Tẹ kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ sí i láàrin ọjọ́ # lẹ́yìn tí o bẹ̀rẹ̀ eré orí ayélujára.}}

growth.invite.linked.text: A ti fi kóòdù ọ̀rẹ́ rẹ pamọ́.

growth.share.explain.en: {days, plural, one {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # day under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.} other {The server checks this replay and keeps it for # days under a code. Anyone with the link can watch it. The base is shown without its name and your opponent is never named.}}
growth.share.explain.text: {days, plural, other {Sáfà máa ń ṣàyẹ̀wò àtúnwò yìí, á sì pa á mọ́ fún ọjọ́ # lábẹ́ kóòdù kan. Ẹnikẹ́ni tí ó ní ìjápọ̀ náà lè wò ó. A ń fi ibùdó náà hàn láìsí orúkọ rẹ̀, a kò sì ní dárúkọ alátakò rẹ láé.}}

growth.share.minor.en: Your name is not shown on replays shared by players under 18.
growth.share.minor.text: A kò fi orúkọ rẹ hàn lórí àtúnwò tí àwọn òṣèré tí kò tíì pé ọmọ ọdún 18 pín.

growth.viewer.generated.en: Against a generated base (made by the computer).
growth.viewer.generated.text: Lòdì sí ibùdó tí kọ̀ǹpútà ṣe.

growth.viewer.failed.en: This shared replay could not be opened.
growth.viewer.failed.text: A kò lè ṣí àtúnwò tí a pín yìí.

growth.viewer.older.en: This replay was recorded under other battle rules, so this version of the game cannot show it.
growth.viewer.older.text: A ṣe àkọsílẹ̀ àtúnwò yìí lábẹ́ òfin ogun mìíràn, nítorí náà ẹ̀dà eré yìí kò lè fi í hàn.

alliance.banner.next.text: Àsíá tó kàn ní ìpele Àjọṣepọ̀ {level}.

alliance.banner.note.en: Banners only change how the Alliance looks: no advantage in battle or resources.
alliance.banner.note.text: Àsíá kàn ń yí ìrísí Àjọṣepọ̀ padà ni: kò fún ọ ní àǹfààní kankan nínú ogun tàbí ohun-ìní.

stats.tzNote.en: It also sends your time zone's offset from UTC, so days are counted on your own calendar.
stats.tzNote.text: Ó tún ń fi ìyàtọ̀ agbègbè àkókò rẹ sí UTC ránṣẹ́, kí a lè ka àwọn ọjọ́ lórí kàlẹ́ńdà tìrẹ.

preview.notLive.en: Preview: this is not in the live game yet.
preview.notLive.text: Àkọ́wò: èyí kò tíì sí nínú eré gidi.

heroPick.intro.en: Choose the hero who joins your attacks.
heroPick.intro.text: Yan akọni tí yóò darapọ̀ mọ́ ìkọlù rẹ.

heroPick.none.en: No hero can join yet. Heroes join from higher Keep levels.
heroPick.none.text: Kò sí akọni tí ó lè darapọ̀ báyìí. Àwọn akọni máa ń darapọ̀ láti àwọn ìpele Ilé Olódi tí ó ga jù.

heroPick.joining.text: Ó ń darapọ̀ mọ́ ìkọlù rẹ: {hero}, ìpele {level}

mastery.none.en: Attack with your warriors to earn mastery.
mastery.none.text: Kọlù pẹ̀lú àwọn jagunjagun rẹ láti jèrè ìmọ̀ ọ̀gá.

seal.progress.en: Keep seal: {n} of {total} buildings at this Keep's cap. A full Keep earns its seal.
seal.progress.text: Èdìdì Ilé Olódi: ilé {n} nínú {total} ti dé òpin ìpele Ilé Olódi yìí. Ilé Olódi tí ó pé ń jèrè èdìdì rẹ̀.

seal.done.text: A ti fi èdìdì di Ilé Olódi {keep}

seal.count.text: Àwọn Ilé Olódi tí a ti fi èdìdì dì: {list}

chat.presetOnly.text: Àwọn gbólóhùn tí a ti ṣe sílẹ̀ nìkan ni a ń fi hàn.

terms.body.en: The terms of service for Kagemura came into force on {date}. Please read them and accept them to play online. Your village keeps working on this device either way.
terms.body.text: Òfin ìlò Kagemura bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí í ṣiṣẹ́ ní {date}. Jọ̀wọ́ kà á kí o sì gbà á láti ṣeré lórí ayélujára. Abúlé rẹ yóò máa ṣiṣẹ́ lórí ẹ̀rọ yìí lọ bó ti wù kí ó rí.

consent.apple.label.en: Help Apple decide refund requests (off until you turn it on)
consent.apple.label.text: Ran Apple lọ́wọ́ láti pinnu ìbéèrè ìdápadà owó (ó wà ní pípa títí o fi tàn án)

consent.apple.detail.en: When you ask Apple for a refund, Apple may ask us about the purchase. With this on, we tell Apple that it was delivered and give ranges for how old your account is and how much you have bought and been refunded. Never your name, village or chat. We never ask Apple to refuse a refund.
consent.apple.detail.text: Nígbà tí o bá béèrè ìdápadà owó lọ́wọ́ Apple, Apple lè bi wá léèrè nípa rírà náà. Tí èyí bá wà ní títàn, a ó sọ fún Apple pé a ti fi í jíṣẹ́, a ó sì fún un ní ìwọ̀n bí àkáǹtì rẹ ti pẹ́ tó àti iye tí o ti rà àti tí a ti dá padà fún ọ. Kì í ṣe orúkọ rẹ, abúlé rẹ tàbí ìjíròrò rẹ láé. A kò ní ní kí Apple kọ ìdápadà owó láé.

replays.allowBase.label.en: Allow my base in other players' shared replays
replays.allowBase.label.text: Gba ibùdó mi láàyè nínú àtúnwò tí àwọn òṣèré mìíràn pín

replays.allowBase.detail.en: When someone shares a replay of a raid on your village, it shows your base layout (never your name). Turn this off and your base is never shown, and shares already made of it are removed.
replays.allowBase.detail.text: Nígbà tí ẹnìkan bá pín àtúnwò ìgbógunti sí abúlé rẹ, ó ń fi ìtò ibùdó rẹ hàn (kì í ṣe orúkọ rẹ láé). Pa èyí, a kò sì ní fi ibùdó rẹ hàn láé, a ó sì yọ àwọn àtúnwò tí a ti pín tí ó fi í hàn kúrò.

significantUpdate.description.en: This update changes how Kagemura works. A parent or guardian can review it before it is used.
significantUpdate.description.text: Àtúnṣe yìí ń yí bí Kagemura ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ padà. Òbí tàbí alágbàtọ́ lè ṣàyẹ̀wò rẹ̀ kí a tó lò ó.

season.recap.en: League at season end: {league}. Raids won: {raids}. Stars: {stars}. Scroll tiers: {tiers}.
season.recap.text: Líìgì ní òpin àsìkò: {league}. Ìgbógunti tí o borí: {raids}. Ìràwọ̀: {stars}. Ìpele Ìwé-àkájọ: {tiers}.

welcome.scrollEnded.en: The Season Scroll ended, and the rewards you had not claimed were added:
welcome.scrollEnded.text: Ìwé-àkájọ Àsìkò ti parí, a sì ti fi àwọn ẹ̀bùn tí o kò tíì gbà fún ọ:

pass.bonus.detail.en: {left, plural, =0 {All {max} bonuses collected this season ({got} of {max})} one {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # point ({got} of {max} this season)} other {Every task still pays: the next bonus in # points ({got} of {max} this season)}}
pass.bonus.detail.text: {left, plural, =0 {O ti gba gbogbo àfikún {max} ní àsìkò yìí ({got} nínú {max})} other {Iṣẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan ṣì ń mú èrè wá: àmì # ló kù kí àfikún tó kàn dé ({got} nínú {max} ní àsìkò yìí)}}
